status: research; nothing here is read by the build. Site figures computed on site/data.json of 2026-10-25 (round 47 live)
question: Does a supply-side allocation model (Russia's actual total exports of each product x the country's pre-war share) predict purchases from Russia better than the current site rule?

rule.written: 2026-10-25, before any back-test result was computed
rule.candidate: SUP: no-war purchases(c, p, t) = Russia's actual total exports of p to all destinations in t (volume) x c's pre-war share of Russia's exports of p. Back-test: start level x T(p,t)/T(p,o), T = the BACI sum over every importer of Russia's exports of p, deflated by the same world unit-value index as the case's actual (so on BACI the error is exactly the drift of c's value share); on Eurostat physical volumes T is Russia's total in BACI tonnes (crude, oil products, coal; unit value within x1/3-x3 of the world's) and deflated value for gas
rule.observed_total: the observed total of year t is used in the back-test for year t, because it is observed at computation time in the war years too
rule.reference: CUR, the current site rule: origin year held flat where the country's purchases from Russia are EUR 0.1bn a year or more (round 47), else the median of the last three years x the round-47 small-flow bias factor (cf_models_r47.json). SUP uses the same start (origin share; for small countries the median of the last three years' shares) and, for small countries, its own bias factor measured the same way (median cumulative error over the S country cases, origins 2005-2016 pooled; for the placebo only the training origins). Also reported: M0 (plain flat) and D (round 48's demand model, exactly as published)
rule.error: the site's cumulative error: log(sum w*actual / sum w*predicted) over H = 1..5 years, w = 1 except 8/12 for the fifth year; per origin the mean over H1-H5 of the median absolute error
accept_if_all: accuracy: SUP's error at least 15% lower than CUR's at EVERY rolling origin 2005-2016 (12 origins, incl. 2008 and 2013/2014), at least 5 cases at each origin
band: SUP's era-calibrated 90% band for the five-year sum (H5; eras 2005-09, 2010-12, 2013-16) not wider in log width than CUR's

placebo: SUP's band, built only from earlier origins, covers at least 90% of the errors for the war moved to 2014 (origin 2013, H5; training origins up to 2008) and to 2018 (origin 2017, H4; up to 2013); under 10 placebo cases: the product pooled over sizes
rule.cells: product x size class of the product flow (S < EUR 0.1bn, M 0.1-1bn, L > 1bn, 4-year average; flows under EUR 10m left out). Products: crude 2709, oil products 2710, gas 2711, coal 2701, cereals HS10, fertilisers 31, metals 72-76, other goods. Fuels judged on Eurostat energy imports by country of origin for European reporters, BACI elsewhere; other goods on BACI (as round 48)
rule.secondary: SUPT (the total from Russia's own log-linear trend over the ten years to the origin; no war-time information) is judged by the same rule and reported; it is proposed only if SUP fails and SUPT passes
rule.diagnostics_only: SUPrep (Russia's own customs totals, UN Comtrade), SUPq (tonnes instead of deflated value, BACI fuels), COMB (geometric mean of the supply-side ratio and round 48's buyer-side ratio, lambda 0.5)
rule.no_narrow_pass: a cell that fails narrowly fails; the rule is not changed after the results
rule.war_time_totals: crude: observed; oil products: observed 2022-2023, held at 2023 from 2024 (refinery strikes, export bans); gas: current method (Russia's own cut); coal: observed (flagged); cereals, fertilisers: observed; metals, other goods: current method in the proposal (sanctions-shaped totals; gold through hubs), model only in the diagnostic
rule.hubs: ARM, GEO, KAZ, KGZ, UZB, TUR, AZE, MNG, TJK, SRB, ARE, BLR, HKG keep the current method in both variants
rule.proposal: passing cells x valid-total products x non-hub countries with purchases of EUR 0.1bn a year or more
rule.diagnostic: SUP on every product except gas (and the rest of HS 27), every non-hub country

source.crude: 2021: Russia's customs report, HS 2709, 231.6 Mt (UN Comtrade); 2022-2025: CREA tracked volumes (seaborne and pipeline); 2026: 9 months of CREA on the same months of 2025
source.products: CREA tracked volumes, each year on the same months of the year before (2026: 9 months); held at 2023 from 2024 (refinery strikes, export bans)
source.coal: CREA tracked volumes, each year on the same months of the year before (2026: 9 months)
source.cereal: USDA PSD, Russia's wheat + barley + corn exports, calendar years as the mean of two marketing years
source.fert: BACI (mirror data), importers present in both 2021 and the year, over Russia's own unit-value index; 2025-2026 held at 2024
source.metal: BACI (mirror data), importers present in both 2021 and the year, over Russia's own unit-value index; 2025-2026 held at 2024
source.other: BACI (mirror data), importers present in both 2021 and the year, over Russia's own unit-value index; 2025-2026 held at 2024
source.gas: not used (current method); BACI tonnes, mostly LNG

wartime_total_index.note: BACI's war-time totals are mirror data and miss importers that stopped reporting; they were the pre-registered source and are kept here for comparison (baci_raw_index)
